name: Sentura Agents
description: Host-side workspace management for AI employees. Exposes gateway RPCs for writing, reading, listing, and deleting files inside an employee's workspace subdirectories (skills/, ekg/, memory/users/) that OpenClaw's built-in agents.files.* RPCs do not cover. Used by the Creator agent's employee-deployment skill to materialize a designed employee entirely from inside its sandbox.

workspaceRoot.description: Root directory where employee workspaces live. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/workspace/

allowedPrefixes.description: Relative-path prefixes an agent is allowed to write under. Paths outside these prefixes are rejected. The eight OpenClaw-native files (AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md, HEARTBEAT.md, BOOTSTRAP.md, MEMORY.md) are always rejected here and must go through agents.files.set.

maxFileBytes.description: Maximum bytes a single subfile write may carry. Default 512 KiB.

maxPathDepth.description: Maximum number of path segments allowed in a relative path (defense in depth against deep-nesting attacks).
